newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia Jan-Sept trade surplus widens to $18.1 bln.
newsitem.headline: Russia Jan-Sept trade surplus widens to $18.1 bln.

text.p: Russia posted a trade surplus of $18.1 billion in the first nine months of this year after a $17.1 billion surplus in the same period of 1995, the State Statistics Committee said on Wednesday.
RUSSIAN MERCHANDISE TRADE Jan-Sep 96 Jan-Aug 96 Jan-Sep 95

Notes -- Figures in billion dollars, FOB. Data are for trade with Russia's "far abroad" excluding former Soviet states. Including trade with former Soviet republics, the surplus widened to $17.1 billion from $16.2 billion.
